Title: Properties of Substances
Content: In order to learn about the properties of different substances, a group of students conducted a series of investigations. In the `text(first)` investigation, the group added `5` `text(grams)` of water and `5` `text(grams)` of iron filings (small pieces of iron) to an empty container that had a mass of `25` `text(grams)`. The container was then sealed, shaken, and left undisturbed overnight.

The `text(next day)`, the students noticed that the color of some of the filings had changed from black to a dark red. The students then measured the mass of the iron filings, water, and container and found it to be `35` `text(grams)`.
